entities.text: HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE AT ALLAHABAD
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 1. Heard learned counsel for the parties.

2. This Court on 26.04.2024 proceeded to pass the following order:
"Short counter affidavit filed today by learned counsel for the opposite party no. 2, is taken on record.
Heard learned counsel for the applicants, learned counsel for the opposite party no.2 and learned A.G.A. for the State.

The present 482 Cr.P.C. application has been filed to quash the Charge Sheet No.01 dated 19.01.2020, under sections 498-A, 323, 504, 506 IPC and 3/4 D.P. Act and 354-B IPC, Police Station Mahila Thana submitted by Investigating Officer against Ram Kumar And 4 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 10 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/84797038/
1 the applicants in Case No.1136/2020, State vs. Ram Kumar and others, in Case Crime No.0181 of 2019, P.S. Mahila Thana, Meerut, District Meerut, pending in the Court of Civil Judge, Junior Division, Fast Track Court, Women Protection Meerut, District Meerut.
Learned counsel for the applicants submit that the parties have amicably settled their disputes vide compromise dated 25.03.2021 which has been placed as Annexure No.
1 to the short counter affidavit dated 30.7.2023.
Looking to the facts of the case, it is provided that the parties shall appear and file the said compromise before the Court concerned, who shall verify the same within 30 days thereafter and send his report to this Court.

entities.text: Court of Civil Judge, Junior Division, Fast Track Court, Women Protection Meerut, District Meerut
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: List this case on 27.05.2024 in the additional cause list alongwith the Verification Report.

In the meantime, no coercive measures shall be taken against the appellants under the aforesaid case crime."
3.

There is a report dated 17.05.2024 of the Additional Civil Judge, Junior Division, court no. 2,
Meerut mentioning therein that the parties had entered into compromise and the same has been verified also.

sentences.text:
4. Learned AGA for the State and learned counsel for the opposite party do not dispute the said fact.
5.

6. In view of the above, the Charge-sheet No. 01 dated 19.01.20 u/s 498A, 323, 504 506 IPC and 3/4 D.P. Act and 354-B I.P.C. at Police Station- Mahila 2020 submitted by Investigating Officer against the applicants in Case No. 1136 of 2020 State Vs Ram Kumar and others, in Case crime No.
0181/2019, U/S 498A Thana Meerut, District Meerut, pending before the Court of Civil Judge Junior Division Fast Track Court Women Protection Meerut, District Meerut are hereby quashed.
